decisions.reason: Removing outer quotation marks from one Mama's Hot Take section does not change the existing requirement that its text be italicized.
The dedication update is already represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event, so no additional or incomplete MODIFY exists.
The reported content edits do not designate a new authoritative manuscript source or alter the existing rule that client updates must be preserved.
The quotation-mark and punctuation corrections concern manuscript text and do not change chapter illustration selection, placement, or rendering requirements.
The source does not identify the copyright page as the location of either correction and does not change its content or layout state.
The source does not connect the removed quotation marks or duplicate full stop to Chapter 12 heading hierarchy or capitalization.
The manuscript corrections do not address or resolve the uncertain interior title-page layout.
Removing quotation marks and a duplicate full stop does not change trim size, paragraph spacing, page density, or other interior layout state.
The source concerns a Mama's Hot Take section and an unspecified duplicate full stop, not the book title's literal newline artifact.
The manuscript content corrections do not alter the paperback cover artifact, content, dimensions, or review requirements.
